missions.title: Enter the Digital Heritage Museum
missions.brief: Welcome. Walk through the grand entrance and speak with the Archive Guide terminal at the reception desk.
missions.objective: Reach the Archive Guide terminal in the lobby

missions.title: Discover Early Life
missions.brief: Door 1 — Early Life & Education. Walk the timeline from 1891 to 1923 and open at least two exhibits.
missions.objective: Open 2 exhibits in the Early Life gallery

missions.title: Explore Social Reform
missions.brief: Door 2 — Social Reform. Study the movement and complete the Match & Verify challenge.

missions.title: Enter the Constitution Gallery
missions.brief: Door 3 — Law & Constitution. Read the Preamble at the Constitution Table and pass the Preamble Challenge.

missions.title: Search the Manuscript Archive
missions.brief: Door 4 — Books, Manuscripts & Scholarship. Use the archive terminal to search the collection.
missions.objective: Run a search at the archive terminal

missions.title: Visit the Digital Memorials
missions.brief: Door 5 — Memorials & Historical Places. Choose a site on the memorial map and visit its reconstruction.

missions.title: Complete the Legacy Archive
missions.brief: Door 6 — Legacy & Digital Archive. Ask the Archive Guide a question and review your Digital Archive collection.
missions.objective: Ask the AI Archive Guide one question

missions.title: Final Knowledge Challenge
missions.brief: Return to the Legacy Archive's Knowledge Centre. Complete the multi-stage final challenge to earn the title HERITAGE ARCHIVIST.
